name: Newgreens Chatswood
why: Tier B on OSM data of 2026-10-28 (his overpass turbo export of 2026-10-28, ff675c61), but OSM's holes are the old 18-hole Chatswood Golf Club. The course reopened in May 2026 as Newgreens Chatswood, 12 holes (imports/chatswood.json, par 44, 2,871 m): OSM's lines differ in par on 4, 8 and 11 and in length on 2, 4, 5, 11 and 12, and its greens and bunkers are the old ones. So the map is the boundary only (shapes: false) and every hole comes from his marks. Rebuild from OSM once it has the new layout.
